note: The desk register: what this newsroom is configured to run, in one place. Two checks read it. The canary asserts the workflow files match it exactly, so a stale cron or a placeholder cannot survive a push. The morning tally compares the Actions log and the ledger to it and prints one health line. Cron times are UTC; the ET column is Eastern and shifts by an hour when DST ends on 1 November.
worker_dispatches: watcher.yml on the half hour during US hours
crypto-news-brief.yml at the evening slot, as the cron's backstop
morning-read.yml at 8:15 AM America/New_York, computed by the Worker

crypto-news-brief.yml.purpose: The one Edition run a day. Ingest, edit, verify, write, approve, publish.
crypto-news-brief.yml.note: One scheduled Edition plus at most two breaking runs fired by the caged watcher. Everything else stands down at the slot guard.

watcher.yml.purpose: The caged breaking-news watcher. No model call unless the cage clears.
watcher.yml.note: Earning categories only, five sources, two runs a day, price triggers off. A tick that does not clear the cage makes no model call.

morning-read.yml.purpose: The morning read (Program 7, Sprint 7.2). The Worker dispatches it at 8:15 AM America/New_York; the two crons are backstops, one per offset, and stand down outside 8 to 11 AM Eastern or once today's read is written. Re-ranks the wire, writes the read, ends in the day's one morning build.
morning-read.yml.note: One model call, a few thousand tokens. A fallback is a clean green run; the alarm fires on the second morning in a row.

site-refresh.yml.purpose: Retired on the deploy budget, 21 September 2026. This fired at 12:00 UTC, 8 AM Eastern, while the Worker also fired this desk's build hook at noon Eastern. Both are retired: the morning read's build (morning-read.yml, 8:15 AM Eastern) replaced them on 12 October 2026. Kept for workflow_dispatch so a refresh can be asked for by hand.
